Sources and status

The rules Passage keeps

They hold on every page, and the tests in the source code check them.

  • Every figure is dated

    Each panel carries its own date stamp, so a late source reads as late instead of current.

  • Every event is sourced

    Each event links to the reporting behind it. Events reported by only one side are marked as claimed.

  • Nothing is filled in

    No position, price or count is estimated between reports. A gap in the data stays a gap on the page.

  • What happened next, not why

    Prices and odds beside an event are dated observations, never a measured effect of that event.

  • Free and public

    Passage uses only free public sources and asks nothing of you: no account, no cookie and no analytics.

Missing stays missing. Nothing is estimated, extrapolated or filled in.

How to read each panel

Privacy

Passage sets no cookie, keeps no account and runs no analytics. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, and its data comes from the Passage collector on Cloudflare Workers. Both receive the usual details of each request, such as your IP address, under their own privacy policies.

Links to publishers and to Polymarket open their own sites, which have their own policies.

Terms of use

Passage is provided as is, for information. It is not a nautical chart, not navigation advice and not financial advice. A figure can be late, partial or wrong when its source is, which is why each one names its source and date.

Each source keeps its own terms. IMF PortWatch data are used under the IMF terms with attribution, EIA data are in the public domain, and headlines stay with their publishers, who are linked from every one.

Credits

Transits: UN Global Platform and IMF PortWatch. Oil prices: U.S. Energy Information Administration. Vessel positions: AISStream, and AISHub contributors (aishub.net) relayed by Open Waters AIS. Market odds: Polymarket. War events: curated from linked reporting and the IMO Middle East highlighted incidents register.

Terrain: Mapzen Terrain Tiles (USGS SRTM and GMTED2010, NOAA ETOPO1). Ship models drawn with the Anatomy kit (MIT). Type set in Geist and Geist Mono (SIL Open Font License). Icons from Phosphor (MIT).
